# agents.md — PanelCraft

Agentic development conventions for this repository. **Humans:** this file is also for
you — it is the contributor handbook in condensed form. Full product spec:
[docs/SPEC.md](docs/SPEC.md). Format spec: [docs/FILE-FORMAT.md](docs/FILE-FORMAT.md).

## Project in one paragraph

Client-only web app for IcePanel-style architecture diagrams (IcePanel = inspiration
only, no links/affiliation in docs): WYSIWYG SVG canvas + always-visible code view,
native `.pcd` format (own grammar, mermaid-inspired), mermaid import/export converters,
flows/animation, multi-file workspace in browser storage only (nothing server-side),
ZIP import/export, GitHub Pages hostable, single Go binary (serve + validate/convert/
render CLI). License **GPL-3.0-only**.

## Ground rules (non-negotiable)

1. **License**: every new source file starts with the GPL-3.0 SPDX header
   (`// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only`). Deps must be GPL-compatible
   (MIT/Apache-2.0/BSD); new dependency ⇒ ADR first.
2. **Milestones are the contract** (SPEC §9). New ideas → backlog (SPEC §12), never
   silently expanded scope.
3. **Quality gates** (SPEC §8): Go `staticcheck` + `gocyclo ≤10/15`; TS `eslint`
   complexity ≤12, `tsc --noEmit` clean; **coverage ≥80% on core packages** (vitest
   thresholds enforce); corpus parity TS⇄Go is a CI gate.
4. **No unverified claims**: every "done" statement cites the command that proves it
   (test run, e2e pass, screenshot review). Mark unverified work as such.
5. **Storage stays browser-local.** Any change that adds a network call (beyond static
   asset load) violates SPEC FR-S1/N7 — reject in review. E2E no-network test is the
   enforcement.
6. **Docs stay human-readable.** agents.md and docs/ are written for people first;
   agent-optimized pointers secondary. No IcePanel URLs in docs (name-as-inspiration
   only).
7. **Architecture docs are written in PanelCraft itself** (SPEC §14): all architecture
   diagrams live as `.pcd` files under `docs/architecture/` — never ASCII/Mermaid art
   in Markdown. They are corpus seeds; keep them grammar-valid (FILE-FORMAT.md) and
   re-validate via `panelcraft validate docs/architecture` once M1 lands. Prose docs
   stay Markdown; normative content never lives in a picture alone.
8. **No external dependencies at runtime, no CDN — ever** (SPEC N7/N11): no external
   origins, no webfonts, no CDN scripts; everything inlined in the bundle / Go binary.
   Build works offline after one-time `npm ci` + `go mod download`. CI asset-origin
   scan (`scripts/check-selfcontained.sh`) + network-blocked e2e are the gates — a PR
   adding an external URL to a resource load must be rejected.

## Commands

```bash
# web
npm ci                       # install (lockfile committed)
npm run dev                  # vite dev server :5173
npm run check                # tsc + eslint (CI gate)
npm test                     # vitest run + coverage thresholds
npm run e2e                  # playwright (build first: npm run build)
npm run build                # static bundle → web/dist

# go
go build ./...               # bin: panelcraft (embeds web/dist — build web first)
go test ./...                # unit + corpus parity
go vet ./... && staticcheck ./...
gocyclo -over 15 cmd internal web && echo OK   # CI fails >15; target ≤10
                                               # (scoped: node_modules ships Go code)

# cli smoke
panelcraft validate testdata/corpus
panelcraft convert testdata/corpus/checkout.pcd -o /tmp/x.pcd
panelcraft serve --addr :8080 --open
```

## Definition of done (per task)

- [ ] Real check run and pasted as evidence (not "should pass")
- [ ] Coverage gate green for touched packages
- [ ] Complexity gates green (no new `// rationale:` exceptions without ADR)
- [ ] E2E scenario green if UI-touching; screenshots captured
- [ ] **Vision review pass if UI-touching**: screenshots reviewed against
      docs/STYLE-GUIDE.md checklist; defects filed or fixed (SPEC §8.4)
- [ ] Docs updated (SPEC/FILE-FORMAT/ARCHITECTURE/CHANGELOG as applicable)
- [ ] GPL headers present on new files

## Working conventions

* **Small diffs, one concern per change.** No opportunistic cleanup, no drive-by
  reformatting.
* **SOLID**: engine packages depend on interfaces (ports), not concrete impls
  (LayoutEngine, Storage, Clock, AnimPlayer are ports). See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
* **Parser changes**: touch `engine/format` + golden corpus in the same change; run
  parity both sides before pushing. Never hand-edit `*.ir.json` goldens — regenerate
  via `npm run corpus:accept` / `go run ./internal/corpus -accept` and diff-review.
* **Tests**: unit-test the failing behavior first (test-first for bugfixes); no test
  weakening to get green; flaky test = fix root cause, no retries/skips.
* **Commits**: imperative subject ≤72 chars, body explains *why*; reference FR-/SPEC-§.
* **Branches**: `feat/<milestone>-<slug>`, PRs into `main`; CI must be green before
  merge (no direct pushes to main).

## E2E + vision loop (UI work)

1. Implement → `npm run build` → `npm run e2e` (Playwright chromium).
2. Screenshot baselines land in `e2e/__screenshots__/`; review diffs deliberately.
3. Open the app (dev server or built dist) via browser automation; capture milestone
   screenshots (light+dark).

# agents.md — PanelCraft

Agentic development conventions for this repository. **Humans:** this file is also for
you — it is the contributor handbook in condensed form. Full product spec:
[docs/SPEC.md](docs/SPEC.md). Format spec: [docs/FILE-FORMAT.md](docs/FILE-FORMAT.md).

## Project in one paragraph

Client-only web app for IcePanel-style architecture diagrams (IcePanel = inspiration
only, no links/affiliation in docs): WYSIWYG SVG canvas + always-visible code view,
native `.pcd` format (own grammar, mermaid-inspired), mermaid import/export converters,
flows/animation, multi-file workspace in browser storage only (nothing server-side),
ZIP import/export, GitHub Pages hostable, single Go binary (serve + validate/convert/
render CLI). License **GPL-3.0-only**.

## Ground rules (non-negotiable)

1. **License**: every new source file starts with the GPL-3.0 SPDX header
   (`// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only`). Deps must be GPL-compatible
   (MIT/Apache-2.0/BSD); new dependency ⇒ ADR first.
2. **Milestones are the contract** (SPEC §9). New ideas → backlog (SPEC §12), never
   silently expanded scope.
3. **Quality gates** (SPEC §8): Go `staticcheck` + `gocyclo ≤10/15`; TS `eslint`
   complexity ≤12, `tsc --noEmit` clean; **coverage ≥80% on core packages** (vitest
   thresholds enforce); corpus parity TS⇄Go is a CI gate.
4. **No unverified claims**: every "done" statement cites the command that proves it
   (test run, e2e pass, screenshot review). Mark unverified work as such.
5. **Storage stays browser-local.** Any change that adds a network call (beyond static
   asset load) violates SPEC FR-S1/N7 — reject in review. E2E no-network test is the
   enforcement.
6. **Docs stay human-readable.** agents.md and docs/ are written for people first;
   agent-optimized pointers secondary. No IcePanel URLs in docs (name-as-inspiration
   only).
7. **Architecture docs are written in PanelCraft itself** (SPEC §14): all architecture
   diagrams live as `.pcd` files under `docs/architecture/` — never ASCII/Mermaid art
   in Markdown. They are corpus seeds; keep them grammar-valid (FILE-FORMAT.md) and
   re-validate via `panelcraft validate docs/architecture` once M1 lands. Prose docs
   stay Markdown; normative content never lives in a picture alone.
8. **No external dependencies at runtime, no CDN — ever** (SPEC N7/N11): no external
   origins, no webfonts, no CDN scripts; everything inlined in the bundle / Go binary.
   Build works offline after one-time `npm ci` + `go mod download`. CI asset-origin
   scan (`scripts/check-selfcontained.sh`) + network-blocked e2e are the gates — a PR
   adding an external URL to a resource load must be rejected.

## Commands

```bash
# web
npm ci                       # install (lockfile committed)
npm run dev                  # vite dev server :5173
npm run check                # tsc + eslint (CI gate)
npm test                     # vitest run + coverage thresholds
npm run e2e                  # playwright (build first: npm run build)
npm run build                # static bundle → web/dist

# go
go build ./...               # bin: panelcraft (embeds web/dist — build web first)
go test ./...                # unit + corpus parity
go vet ./... && staticcheck ./...
gocyclo -over 15 cmd internal web && echo OK   # CI fails >15; target ≤10
                                               # (scoped: node_modules ships Go code)

# cli smoke
panelcraft validate testdata/corpus
panelcraft convert testdata/corpus/checkout.pcd -o /tmp/x.pcd
panelcraft serve --addr :8080 --open
```

## Definition of done (per task)

- [ ] Real check run and pasted as evidence (not "should pass")
- [ ] Coverage gate green for touched packages
- [ ] Complexity gates green (no new `// rationale:` exceptions without ADR)
- [ ] E2E scenario green if UI-touching; screenshots captured
- [ ] **Vision review pass if UI-touching**: screenshots reviewed against
      docs/STYLE-GUIDE.md checklist; defects filed or fixed (SPEC §8.4)
- [ ] Docs updated (SPEC/FILE-FORMAT/ARCHITECTURE/CHANGELOG as applicable)
- [ ] GPL headers present on new files

## Working conventions

* **Small diffs, one concern per change.** No opportunistic cleanup, no drive-by
  reformatting.
* **SOLID**: engine packages depend on interfaces (ports), not concrete impls
  (LayoutEngine, Storage, Clock, AnimPlayer are ports). See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
* **Parser changes**: touch `engine/format` + golden corpus in the same change; run
  parity both sides before pushing. Never hand-edit `*.ir.json` goldens — regenerate
  via `npm run corpus:accept` / `go run ./internal/corpus -accept` and diff-review.
* **Tests**: unit-test the failing behavior first (test-first for bugfixes); no test
  weakening to get green; flaky test = fix root cause, no retries/skips.
* **Commits**: imperative subject ≤72 chars, body explains *why*; reference FR-/SPEC-§.
* **Branches**: `feat/<milestone>-<slug>`, PRs into `main`; CI must be green before
  merge (no direct pushes to main).

## E2E + vision loop (UI work)

1. Implement → `npm run build` → `npm run e2e` (Playwright chromium).
2. Screenshot baselines land in `e2e/__screenshots__/`; review diffs deliberately.
3. Open the app (dev server or built dist) via browser automation; capture milestone
   screenshots (light+dark).

## 1. Sequencing overview (critical path)

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
#
# verify.sh — CI-equivalent local gate runner (agents.md / SPEC §8).
#
# Usage:
#   bash scripts/verify.sh <milestone> [stage...]   run all stages, or named subset
#   bash scripts/verify.sh <milestone> --list       list stages
#
# Milestones:
#   m0  scaffolding gate: web check+test+build, go vet/staticcheck/gocyclo/test,
#       asset-origin scan, e2e no-network smoke.
# Later milestones extend STAGES below (docs/IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md).
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."

MILESTONE="${1:-m0}"
shift || true

log()  { printf '\n\033[1;36m== %s\033[0m\n' "$*"; }
run() { printf '\033[1;33m$ %s\033[0m\n' "$*"; "$@"; }

# ---- m0 stages --------------------------------------------------------------
web_check()   { run npm run check; }
web_test()    { run npm test; }
web_build()   { run npm run build; }
go_vet()      { run go vet ./...; }
go_static()   { run staticcheck ./...; }
go_cyclo() {
  log 'gocyclo -over 15 (CI fails >15; target ≤10)'
  # Scoped to repo-owned dirs: gocyclo has no exclude list and third-party
  # code under node_modules/** must not pollute the gate (M0 decision, M0.md).
  out="$(gocyclo -over 15 cmd internal web || true)"
  if [[ -n "$out" ]]; then
    echo "$out"
    echo "gocyclo: functions above 15 found — FAIL" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "gocyclo: OK (no functions above 15)"
}
go_test()     { run go test ./...; }
selfcontained() { run bash scripts/check-selfcontained.sh web/dist; }
e2e_smoke()   { run npm run e2e -- --project=chromium; }

# ---- m1 stages (M1-WP8 parity gates + WP9 docs validation) ------------------
# corpus_ir: TS⇄Go serializer byte-parity on the shared IR fixture.
corpus_ir()   { run go test ./internal/ir/...; }
# corpus_ts: TS parse/convert output matches committed goldens (all corpus files).
corpus_ts()   { run npm run corpus:check; }
# corpus_go: Go parse/convert output matches the same goldens ⇒ TS⇄Go parity.
corpus_go()   { run go test ./internal/corpus/...; }
# validate_docs: dogfooding gate — PanelCraft's own architecture validates (WP9).
validate_docs() {
  run go run ./cmd/panelcraft validate docs/architecture
}

case "$MILESTONE" in
  m0)
    STAGES=(web_check web_test web_build go_vet go_static go_cyclo go_test selfcontained e2e_smoke)
    ;;
  m1)
    STAGES=(web_check web_test web_build go_vet go_static go_cyclo go_test corpus_ir corpus_ts corpus_go validate_docs selfcontained e2e_smoke)
    ;;
  *)
    echo "verify.sh: unknown milestone '$MILESTONE' (known: m0, m1)" >&2
    exit 2
    ;;
esac

if [[ "${1:-}" == "--list" ]]; then
  printf '%s\n' "${STAGES[@]}"
  exit 0
fi

if (( $# > 0 )); then
  requested=("$@")
  for r in "${requested[@]}"; do
    known=false
    for s in "${STAGES[@]}"; do [[ "$r" == "$s" ]] && known=true; done
    if ! $known; then
      echo "verify.sh: stage '$r' not in $MILESTONE (run with --list)" >&2
      exit 2
    fi
  done
  STAGES=("${requested[@]}")
fi

log "verify.sh — milestone $MILESTONE — ${#STAGES[@]} stage(s)"
failed=()
for stage in "${STAGES[@]}"; do
  log "stage: $stage"
  if ! "$stage"; then
    failed+=("$stage")
    echo "verify.sh: stage '$stage' FAILED" >&2
  fi
done

log "verify.sh — summary"
if (( ${#failed[@]} > 0 )); then
  printf 'FAILED stages: %s\n' "${failed[*]}"
  exit 1
fi
echo "ALL STAGES GREEN — $MILESTONE gate passed"

# STYLE-GUIDE — PanelCraft

Normative visual language for all UI work. Every UI-touching milestone runs the
[screenshot checklist](#screenshot-checklist-vision-review) as a DoD gate
(SPEC §8.4). Tokens below are the single source of truth — components reference
CSS custom properties, never hard-coded values (M2-WP5 enforces).

## Tokens

### Color — light (default)

| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `--pc-bg` | `#ffffff` | page background |
| `--pc-surface` | `#f5f6f8` | panels, toolbars |
| `--pc-fg` | `#1a1d21` | primary text |
| `--pc-muted` | `#6b7280` | secondary text, disabled |
| `--pc-accent` | `#2563eb` | selection, primary actions |
| `--pc-border` | `#d1d5db` | hairlines, separators |
| `--pc-canvas` | `#fafafa` | diagram canvas |

### Color — dark

| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `--pc-bg` | `#14161a` | page background |
| `--pc-surface` | `#1e2126` | panels, toolbars |
| `--pc-fg` | `#e5e7eb` | primary text |
| `--pc-muted` | `#9ca3af` | secondary text, disabled |
| `--pc-accent` | `#60a5fa` | selection, primary actions |
| `--pc-border` | `#374151` | hairlines, separators |
| `--pc-canvas` | `#111316` | diagram canvas |

Rules: contrast ≥ 4.5:1 for body text, ≥ 3:1 for large text/UI glyphs in both
schemes; never rely on hue alone (a11y, M7 pass formalizes audit).

### Spacing — 4 px grid

`--pc-space-1..8` = 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64 px. All margins/paddings/gaps
are multiples of 4 px. No arbitrary px values in components.

### Type scale (system fonts only — no webfonts, N11)

| Step | Size/line | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `--pc-text-xs` | 11/16 px | badges, hints |
| `--pc-text-sm` | 12/18 px | labels, code view gutter |
| `--pc-text-md` | 14/20 px | body, panel UI (default) |
| `--pc-text-lg` | 18/26 px | section titles |
| `--pc-text-xl` | 24/32 px | page titles |

Font stack: `system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif`;
code: `ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace`.

### Shape language

- Corner radii: `--pc-radius-sm` 4 px (inputs, buttons), `--pc-radius-md` 8 px
  (panels, dialogs), objects on canvas 8 px; persons/cylinders per shape glyph.
- Hairline borders 1 px; focus rings 2 px `--pc-accent` (never remove outlines).
- Shadows: two elevations only — `0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1)` (panels),
  `0 8px 24px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.18)` (dialogs/popovers); dark scheme lowers alpha.

### Motion (reduced-motion respected, FR-A?)

- Durations: `--pc-dur-fast` 150 ms (hover/press), `--pc-dur-med` 200 ms
  (panel transitions), `--pc-dur-slow` 300 ms (dialog/theme cross-fade).
  Nothing above 300 ms.
- Easing: `cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)` (standard), `linear` for progress.
- `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` → all transitions ≤ 1 frame; flow animation
  jumps to end states (SPEC FR-F/anim).

### Diagram theme contract (M2+)

Shapes/colors are theme tokens only (M2-WP5) — the same IR must render
sanely in light and dark; screenshots are captured for both in every visual
spec (SPEC §8.3/8.4).

- [ ] Focus/selection states visible (accent ring, no default-blue browser ring)
- [ ] Animation end states: settled frames match static screenshot (no ghosting)
- [ ] Theme parity: light and dark screenshots differ only in token colors —
      no missing dark variant for any glyph/panel
- [ ] No external assets visible (fonts/icons/CDN images) — self-containment
      holds visually (N7/N11)

filed and fixed before DoD.

# STYLE-GUIDE — PanelCraft

Normative visual language for all UI work. Every UI-touching milestone runs the
[screenshot checklist](#screenshot-checklist-vision-review) as a DoD gate
(SPEC §8.4). Tokens below are the single source of truth — components reference
CSS custom properties, never hard-coded values (M2-WP5 enforces).

## Tokens

### Color — light (default)

| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `--pc-bg` | `#ffffff` | page background |
| `--pc-surface` | `#f5f6f8` | panels, toolbars |
| `--pc-fg` | `#1a1d21` | primary text |
| `--pc-muted` | `#6b7280` | secondary text, disabled |
| `--pc-accent` | `#2563eb` | selection, primary actions |
| `--pc-border` | `#d1d5db` | hairlines, separators |
| `--pc-canvas` | `#fafafa` | diagram canvas |

### Color — dark

| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `--pc-bg` | `#14161a` | page background |
| `--pc-surface` | `#1e2126` | panels, toolbars |
| `--pc-fg` | `#e5e7eb` | primary text |
| `--pc-muted` | `#9ca3af` | secondary text, disabled |
| `--pc-accent` | `#60a5fa` | selection, primary actions |
| `--pc-border` | `#374151` | hairlines, separators |
| `--pc-canvas` | `#111316` | diagram canvas |

Rules: contrast ≥ 4.5:1 for body text, ≥ 3:1 for large text/UI glyphs in both
schemes; never rely on hue alone (a11y, M7 pass formalizes audit).

### Spacing — 4 px grid

`--pc-space-1..8` = 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64 px. All margins/paddings/gaps
are multiples of 4 px. No arbitrary px values in components.

### Type scale (system fonts only — no webfonts, N11)

| Step | Size/line | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `--pc-text-xs` | 11/16 px | badges, hints |
| `--pc-text-sm` | 12/18 px | labels, code view gutter |
| `--pc-text-md` | 14/20 px | body, panel UI (default) |
| `--pc-text-lg` | 18/26 px | section titles |
| `--pc-text-xl` | 24/32 px | page titles |

Font stack: `system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif`;
code: `ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace`.

### Shape language

- Corner radii: `--pc-radius-sm` 4 px (inputs, buttons), `--pc-radius-md` 8 px
  (panels, dialogs), objects on canvas 8 px; persons/cylinders per shape glyph.
- Hairline borders 1 px; focus rings 2 px `--pc-accent` (never remove outlines).
- Shadows: two elevations only — `0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1)` (panels),
  `0 8px 24px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.18)` (dialogs/popovers); dark scheme lowers alpha.

### Motion (reduced-motion respected, FR-A?)

- Durations: `--pc-dur-fast` 150 ms (hover/press), `--pc-dur-med` 200 ms
  (panel transitions), `--pc-dur-slow` 300 ms (dialog/theme cross-fade).
  Nothing above 300 ms.
- Easing: `cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)` (standard), `linear` for progress.
- `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` → all transitions ≤ 1 frame; flow animation
  jumps to end states (SPEC FR-F/anim).

### Diagram theme contract (M2+)

Shapes/colors are theme tokens only (M2-WP5) — the same IR must render
sanely in light and dark; screenshots are captured for both in every visual
spec (SPEC §8.3/8.4).

# ADR-0001: Custom SVG rendering engine (no mermaid.js in the editor)

- Status: Accepted
- Date: 2025-11-07
- Context: SPEC D2

## Context

IcePanel-class features — live WYSIWYG editing (drag, resize, inline link creation),
per-step flow animation with camera moves and dimming, tag fading, ghosted imported
objects — require imperative control over the scene graph and animation timeline.

## Options considered

1. **Render with mermaid.js** — faithful mermaid look, zero renderer code.
   Rejected: SVG output is opaque (no stable per-element handles), no editing
   interaction model, animation limited to CSS poking at generated markup; would
   force a "preview-only" mermaid pane and a second editor paradigm. Two paradigms
   = two bugs per feature.
2. **Adopt a graph library (Cytoscape.js / maxGraph / x6)** — faster start for
   pan/zoom/hit-testing. Rejected as core: heavyweight abstractions we'd fight
   (custom data model in, custom serialization out), styling/animation control
   still partial; library churn risk. (Kept as fallback if custom engine blows the
   N1 perf budget — decision point M2.)
3. **Custom SVG engine** — chosen.

## Decision

Build a framework-agnostic TypeScript SVG engine: scene-graph model → SVG DOM,
layers (edges/objects/overlay/animation), hit-testing, viewport transform, WAAPI/
CSS-driven animation. Preact renders UI chrome *around* the canvas, never inside it.

## Consequences

+ Full control of animation, dimming, ghosting, camera; no abstraction fights.
+ Engine packages are plain TS → fast unit tests, no DOM framework coupling.
− We own pan/zoom, hit-testing, edge routing quality (orthogonal routing is the
  hard 20%) — mitigated by dagre for auto-layout (ADR-0004) and perf budget N1.
− Milestone M2 grows; accepted consciously.

# ADR-0004: Dependency policy and the allowed set

- Status: Accepted
- Date: 2025-11-07
- Context: constraint "minimal external dependencies; stdlib first; libraries allowed
  when they remove extreme complexity"

## Policy

1. Default = platform standard library (browser or Go std). A dependency needs a
   written reason: complexity avoided, correctness risk reduced, spec compliance.
2. Runtime (ships to users) deps are held to a stricter bar than dev/build/test deps.
3. Every new dependency: ADR + license compatibility check (GPL-3.0-compatible:
   MIT/Apache-2.0/BSD) + bundle-size note. No transitive-surprise rule: lockfile diff
   reviewed in the same PR.
4. Re-evaluate at M7: anything replaceable by ~100 lines of owned code gets replaced.
5. **Self-containment (SPEC N7/N11)**: nothing may load from a CDN or any external
   origin at runtime — no webfonts, no icon-font/CDN assets, no remote scripts. All
   third-party code ships inside the bundle (vite-inlined) or inside the Go binary
   (`go:embed`). Build must succeed offline after one-time dependency fetch
   (lockfile + `go.sum` committed). CI enforces via asset-origin scan + network-blocked
   e2e.

## Approved runtime set (v1)

| Dependency | Why | Alternative rejected |
|---|---|---|
| preact (+ htm via jsx runtime) | UI chrome: panels, trees, dialogs — state wiring by hand would dominate complexity | vanilla custom vdom (slow, risky); react (heavier) |
| codemirror 6 | code view: incremental parse, diagnostics gutters, performs on big files | textarea + highlighting lib (no gutter/diag model) |
| dagre | layered auto-layout (N1); hand-rolling Sugiyama = high-risk algorithm code | own Sugiyama (post-v1 candidate); ELK (wasm, heavy) |
| chromedp (Go) | headless render CLI via CDP; pure Go, no cgo | os/exec chrome --screenshot (no settle control) |
| fflate *(conditional)* | ZIP fallback **only** when `CompressionStream`/`DecompressionStream` unavailable (Safari <16.4); loaded lazily | always-on zip lib (violates stdlib-first) |

ZIP base path = `CompressionStream`/`DecompressionStream` + thin container code
(owned, unit-tested) — stdlib-first honored; fflate is the documented fallback, not
the default.

## Approved dev/test set

vite, typescript, eslint(+ts), vitest(+fake-indexeddb, jsdom),
@testing-library/preact, playwright(+pixelmatch), staticcheck, gocyclo/gocognit.

## Explicit non-dependencies (v1)

React, state libs (redux/zustand), CSS frameworks (tailwind — hand-rolled design
tokens instead), chart/graph engines (cytoscape/x6), yaml libs (PDL parser is
hand-written), mermaid.js, **anything CDN-loaded** (scripts/webfonts/icon fonts),
Google Fonts / unpkg / jsdelivr or any external origin at runtime.

compaction_tx.summary:
## Primary Request and Intent
- Active goal (goal mode, "azure.puma"): "Deliver milestone M2 — Canvas MVP — per docs/IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md §4, WPs M2-WP1..M2-WP10: viewport+input, scene-graph SVG renderer (layers, diff-patch, stable ids), hit-testing/selection, drag/resize/snap, C4 shape set on theme tokens, link UX with orthogonal router v1, properties panel, undo/redo stack, palette, S1 e2e + vision round 1 + perf baseline."
- Completion criterion: "S1 e2e scenario passes (create diagram via palette drop + link + properties, screenshots light/dark), vision review round 1 recorded in docs/milestones/M2.md with defects closed, perf baseline vs N1 logged, coverage ≥80% engine/render + workspace/undo, and `bash scripts/verify.sh m2` exits 0."
- verifyCommand: `bash scripts/verify.sh m2`. Budget: turns 250, no token budget. Goal ends ONLY via goal tool call with action "update", status "complete"/"blocked" — prose announcements don't count. Stall watchdog requires visible progress per turn.
- agents.md ground rules: GPL-3.0-only SPDX header on every new file; new dependency ⇒ ADR first (ADR-0004 pre-approved jsdom + @testing-library/preact dev set); coverage ≥80% engine+workspace (vitest thresholds); eslint complexity ≤12; `tsc --noEmit` clean; no test weakening; evidence-backed claims; no CDN/external origins; docs human-readable; commits imperative ≤72 chars citing FR-/WP-.

## Key Technical Concepts
- Preact 11 + hooks UI chrome AROUND imperative SVG canvas (ADR-0001: Preact never renders inside the SVG).
- Diff-patch SceneRenderer: 0-op idempotent re-render; move-only = transform attr swap; structural change rebuilds children in same `<g>` (stable identity); selection re-applied after patches.
- Mode state machine in CanvasController: idle/pan/drag/band/link/resize.
- Viewport: screen⇄canvas affine Transform {x,y,k}; zoom clamp 10–400%; anchor-stable zoomAt; wheelGesture: ctrl/cmd+wheel = zoom, plain = pan.
- Snap: GRID_SIZE=8; guides = closest-anchor-pair within 4px threshold per axis; guide hit overrides grid snap (`guided = guides.length > 0` — delta-0 guide still counts).
- Orthogonal router v1: dominant-axis side pick, mid-channel Z route, single-obstacle detour (nearest edge + 12px clearance, tie→hi/below-right).
- UndoStack: 100 cap, injected clock, COALESCE_WINDOW_MS=1000, redo-tail cleared on push; ValueChange<T> with optional `equals` (structural compare for objects; apply() factory forwards it).
- jsdom via per-file `// @vitest-environment jsdom`; noUncheckedIndexedAccess on (array index → T|undefined; use guards or `.at()`); preact Ref<T> type (ComponentRef doesn't exist).
- Tests dispatch MouseEvent('pointerdown'…bubbles) — halo/resize detection uses e.target.closest so dispatch ON the element, not svg.
- addObject(kind, at?) places shape CENTERED at `at` (at = center point, top-left = at − size/2); no-`at` = centerOfView snapped to grid.

## Files and Code
- `web/src/engine/render/viewport.ts` — transforms, clampZoom, zoomAt, fitRect, unionRects, wheelZoomFactor, wheelGesture, KEYMAP/actionFor(key,mod), PAN_STEP_PX=40, ZOOM_STEP=1.2.
- `web/src/engine/render/snap.ts` — snapToGrid (`|| 0` normalizes −0), snapRect, snapResize, computeGuides → {dx,dy,guides[{axis,at,source}]}.
- `web/src/engine/render/router.ts` — portPoint, pickSides, routeOrtho (RouteInput{from,to,obstacles?,clearance?}), arrowDirection, labelPoint, polylineLength, distanceToPolyline; `at(points,i)` invariant guard.
- `web/src/engine/render/hit-test.ts` — pointInRect, rectsIntersect, hitObjects (topmost first, reverse z), objectsInBand, hitLink (slop=6), pick (objects > links).
- `web/src/engine/render/shapes.ts` — ElSpec glyph factory per Kind; person/datastore-cylinder/queue/note-folded/group-boundary/rounded-rect defaults; class-based tokens only (test asserts no hard-coded colors); SHAPE_RADIUS=8, HEAD_R=6, NOTE_FOLD=12.
- `web/src/engine/render/scenegraph.ts` — SceneRenderer: defs+marker#pc-arrow, `.pc-world` wrapper (setWorldTransform), grid pattern (setGrid), layers links/objects/overlay; render(scene)→PatchStats{created,updated,removed,reordered}; structuralKey/structuralKeyLink(label presence only)/polylineKey; setSelection(objIds, linkIds=[]); applySelection re-run when created>0||updated>0; elementFor(id); lastOrder detects reorder (skip when prevOrder==='' i.e. initial).
- `web/src/engine/render/overlay.ts` — clearOverlay, drawRubberBand, drawGuides, drawGhostLink, drawHalos (4 side circles data-id/data-side r=5), drawResizeHandle (bottom-right corner).
- `web/src/workspace/undo.ts` — UndoStack, CoalescableCommand, ValueChange (ctor: set, before, after, coalesceKey, label, equals=Object.is; static apply forwards equals).
- `web/src/ui/CanvasController.ts` (~800 lines) — DiagramObject{id,kind,x,y,w,h,name?,description?,technology?,tags?,dashed?}; DiagramLink{id,from,to,type,label?,dashed?}; DEFAULT_SHAPE per kind (system 160×60, person 120×72, group 320×240, note 160×88, datastore 140×64, queue 140×60); PALETTE_ORDER (9 kinds); Snapshot; opts {undo?, onState?, onRenameRequest?}; addObject (centered at `at`, id `o${seq}`, undoable); quickAdd(1..9); updateObject/updateLink (ValueChange, key `props:<id>`/`link:<id>`); deleteSelection (cascades attached links, closure command); toggleGrid; fitDiagram; loadState; mode machines: beginPanOrHalo (pan on middle/space; haloTarget→link mode; resizeTarget→resize), beginObjectDrag (shift toggle; drag threshold 2px), dragMove (single-sel guides override grid, else snapToGrid), bandMove/commitBand, linkMove (ghost + pc-link-target highlight)/commitLink (type 'uses', id `l${seq}`, closure command), resizeMove (top-left anchored: `x2 = max(before.x+GRID, snapToGrid(p.x))`, snapResize import removed), commitDrag (closure command, key `pos:<id>`/`pos:multi`); commitResize (ValueChange `size:<id>`); handleUndoKeys (mod+z/shift+z/y), handleActionKey, runAction dispatch; selectLink clears selObjects directly (was: selectObjects([]) wiped selLinks — fixed).
- `web/src/ui/App.tsx` — shell: header, Palette | canvas svg.pc-canvas | PropertiesPanel; onPaletteDrop converts client→canvas via viewport; onRenameRequest focuses name field.
- `web/src/ui/Palette.tsx` — click-to-place + pointer drag with body ghost div (.pc-palette-ghost), drop → onDragDrop(kind, ev).
- `web/src/ui/PropertiesPanel.tsx` — name/kind(disabled)/description/technology/tags(comma-parse)/dashed; link: type select (LINK_TYPES: uses, includes, requests, returns, publishes, subscribes, reads, writes, data)/label/dashed; testids: prop-name, prop-description, prop-technology, prop-tags, prop-dashed, link-type, link-label, link-dashed; `import type { Ref } from 'preact'`.
- `web/src/ui/app.css` — full STYLE-GUIDE tokens (light+dark: --pc-bg/surface/fg/muted/accent/border/canvas, --pc-text-xs/sm/md, --pc-radius-sm/md); glyph classes (.pc-shape/.pc-glyph/.pc-label/.pc-route/.pc-arrow/.pc-link-label/.pc-selected/.pc-dashed); shell layout (.app-header/.app-body/.palette 168px/.properties 232px/.palette-item); overlay chrome (.pc-rubber/.pc-guide/.pc-ghost/.pc-halo/.pc-resize-handle/.pc-link-target/.pc-link-selected/.pc-grid-dot).
- `web/src/ui/CanvasController.test.ts` — 21/21 green: viewport wheel/pan/clamp/space-drag/arrows/0-reset; select/drag-snap (200+10→208, 200+3→200); sub-threshold no command; guide overrides grid (drag to x=340 exact edge-align with o2.x=500, grid would give 336/344); shift multi; rubber band; halo drag→link 'uses' + undo/redo; ghost visible; route click (channel x=430, y=330); Delete/mod+z/mod+shift+z; input-typing guard; quick-add ['system','person','datastore']; updateObject undo + DOM label; grid toggle; group resize (433,345 → w=332,h=244 anchored).
- `web/src/ui/App.test.tsx` — 5/6 green: palette 9 kinds render; click-to-place; drag-drop translate(200 124); select→prop-name; name edit + mod+z label revert; FAILING: "tags input parses comma-separated values" — after mod+z expects input value '' but got 'core, billing, v2'.
- `scripts/verify.sh` — m2 stage list added: (web_check web_test perf_smoke web_build go_vet go_static go_cyclo go_test corpus_ir corpus_ts corpus_go validate_docs selfcontained e2e_m2); perf_smoke runs `npx vitest run web/src/engine/render/perf.test.ts` (perf.test.ts NOT YET CREATED — stage will fail until then); e2e_m2 = full playwright run.
- `docs/milestones/M2.md` — WP tracker (WP2/3/5/8 done; WP1/4/6 partial; WP7/9/10 pending), progress log (slices 1–3), router decision section, perf baseline section (empty), DoD checklist (unchecked).
- Tests: viewport.test 15, snap.test 13, router.test 14, hit-test.test 15, shapes.test 9, scenegraph.test 21, undo.test 17, CanvasController.test 21, App.test 6 (1 failing).

## Errors and Fixes
- noUncheckedIndexedAccess errors (router/hit-test): added `at(points,i)` invariant guard, `if (!l) continue`, tests use `.at(i)?.x`.
- Math.round half-up surprises: 12/8→16 (1.5→2), snapResize w=48 not 40 — fixed test expectations, documented "ties round up".
- snapToGrid(-3) → −0 fails toBe(0): `return Math.round(v/g)*g || 0`.

## Primary Request and Intent
- Active goal (goal mode, "azure.puma"): "Deliver milestone M2 — Canvas MVP — per docs/IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md §4, WPs M2-WP1..M2-WP10: viewport+input, scene-graph SVG renderer (layers, diff-patch, stable ids), hit-testing/selection, drag/resize/snap, C4 shape set on theme tokens, link UX with orthogonal router v1, properties panel, undo/redo stack, palette, S1 e2e + vision round 1 + perf baseline."
- Completion criterion: "S1 e2e scenario passes (create diagram via palette drop + link + properties, screenshots light/dark), vision review round 1 recorded in docs/milestones/M2.md with defects closed, perf baseline vs N1 logged, coverage ≥80% engine/render + workspace/undo, and `bash scripts/verify.sh m2` exits 0."
- verifyCommand: `bash scripts/verify.sh m2`. Budget: turns 250, no token budget. Goal ends ONLY via goal tool call with action "update", status "complete"/"blocked" — prose announcements don't count. Stall watchdog requires visible progress per turn.
- agents.md ground rules: GPL-3.0-only SPDX header on every new file; new dependency ⇒ ADR first (ADR-0004 pre-approved jsdom + @testing-library/preact dev set); coverage ≥80% engine+workspace (vitest thresholds); eslint complexity ≤12; `tsc --noEmit` clean; no test weakening; evidence-backed claims; no CDN/external origins; docs human-readable; commits imperative ≤72 chars citing FR-/WP-.

## Key Technical Concepts
- Preact 11 + hooks UI chrome AROUND imperative SVG canvas (ADR-0001: Preact never renders inside the SVG).
- Diff-patch SceneRenderer: 0-op idempotent re-render; move-only = transform attr swap; structural change rebuilds children in same `<g>` (stable identity); selection re-applied after patches.
- Mode state machine in CanvasController: idle/pan/drag/band/link/resize.
- Viewport: screen⇄canvas affine Transform {x,y,k}; zoom clamp 10–400%; anchor-stable zoomAt; wheelGesture: ctrl/cmd+wheel = zoom, plain = pan.
- Snap: GRID_SIZE=8; guides = closest-anchor-pair within 4px threshold per axis; guide hit overrides grid snap (`guided = guides.length > 0` — delta-0 guide still counts).
- Orthogonal router v1: dominant-axis side pick, mid-channel Z route, single-obstacle detour (nearest edge + 12px clearance, tie→hi/below-right).
- UndoStack: 100 cap, injected clock, COALESCE_WINDOW_MS=1000, redo-tail cleared on push; ValueChange<T> with optional `equals` (structural compare for objects; apply() factory forwards it).
- jsdom via per-file `// @vitest-environment jsdom`; noUncheckedIndexedAccess on (array index → T|undefined; use guards or `.at()`); preact Ref<T> type (ComponentRef doesn't exist).
- Tests dispatch MouseEvent('pointerdown'…bubbles) — halo/resize detection uses e.target.closest so dispatch ON the element, not svg.
- addObject(kind, at?) places shape CENTERED at `at` (at = center point, top-left = at − size/2); no-`at` = centerOfView snapped to grid.

## Files and Code
- `web/src/engine/render/viewport.ts` — transforms, clampZoom, zoomAt, fitRect, unionRects, wheelZoomFactor, wheelGesture, KEYMAP/actionFor(key,mod), PAN_STEP_PX=40, ZOOM_STEP=1.2.

**Persona A — Architect (author).** Maintains a workspace of diagrams describing a
system landscape. Creates diagrams visually, refines them in code view, animates flows
to explain request journeys.

**Persona B — Reviewer (reader).** Opens a shared `.pcd` file or ZIP, walks flows in
play mode, exports PNG/SVG for docs.

**Top scenarios (must work end-to-end):**

1. *S1 Create*: new file → drag person/system/container onto canvas → link them → set
   properties → diagram renders live; code view shows updated source.
2. *S2 Code round-trip*: paste a mermaid `C4Container` snippet into code view → canvas
   renders it → edit node in canvas → code view updates; file remains valid mermaid
   (PanelCraft extensions live in comment block).
3. *S3 Flow playback*: define 6-step flow (incl. one `alt`, one `par`) → press Play →
   camera focus + animated edges step-by-step; non-active elements dim.
4. *S4 Workspace IO*: build directory tree `landscape/`, `systems/billing/` → export ZIP →
   clear browser data → import ZIP → identical workspace.
5. *S5 Mermaid import*: open `architecture.mmd` (flowchart + subgraphs) → converted to
   `.pcd`, auto-laid-out, fully editable.
6. *S6 CLI*: `panelcraft validate ./diagrams` lints all files (CI gate);
   `panelcraft render checkout.pcd --out checkout.png` produces a PNG via headless Chrome.
7. *S7 Static hosting*: open the GitHub Pages URL → full functionality offline-capable,
   no backend calls (verified by network monitor in E2E).

## Screenshot checklist (vision review)

Run per milestone on captured light+dark screenshots (e2e loop, agents.md):

- [ ] Alignment: panel edges, icon boxes, and text baselines sit on the 4 px grid
- [ ] Contrast: body text ≥ 4.5:1, muted text still legible on both schemes
- [ ] Spacing: consistent gaps between sibling panels/controls (no 3/5/7 px)
- [ ] Empty states: meaningful message, correct centering, no layout jump on load
- [ ] Focus/selection states visible (accent ring, no default-blue browser ring)
- [ ] Animation end states: settled frames match static screenshot (no ghosting)
- [ ] Theme parity: light and dark screenshots differ only in token colors —
      no missing dark variant for any glyph/panel
- [ ] No external assets visible (fonts/icons/CDN images) — self-containment
      holds visually (N7/N11)

Outcome recorded in `docs/milestones/M<n>.md` with screenshot refs; defects
filed and fixed before DoD.
